MLS expanded to 30 clubs this season with the addition of [[San Diego FC]], an expansion team awarded in 2023.{{cite web | url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37676377/mls-names-san-diego-30th-team-debut-2025 | title=San Diego awarded 30th MLS team, will debut in 2025 | date=May 18, 2023 | access-date=November 9, 2023 | last=Hernandez | first=Cesar | archive-date=May 25, 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230525183116/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37676377/mls-names-san-diego-30th-team-debut-2025 | url-status=live }} The league's 30 teams were divided into the [[Eastern Conference (MLS)|Eastern]] and [[Western Conference (MLS)|Western]] conferences, which each had 15 teams. The regular season ran from February 22 to October 18 and comprised 34 matches for each team, with a schedule that was primarily intra-conference with six inter-conference matches per team.{{cite web | url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/other/san-diego-fc-learns-its-first-two-major-league-soccer-opponents/ar-AA1sFSyF?ocid=BingNewsSerp | title=San Diego FC learns its first two Major League Soccer opponents | last=Zeigler | first=Mark | website=[[MSN]] | date=October 21, 2024 | accessdate=October 21, 2024}} There was a break for the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]] and [[2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup]] in late June but no break for the [[2025 Leagues Cup]] in August. The [[2025 MLS Cup playoffs|playoffs]] began on October 22 and concluded with [[MLS Cup 2025]] on December 6.{{cite news |last=Vertelney |first=Seth |date=December 19, 2024 |title=MLS releases full 2025 schedule |url=https://prosoccerwire.usatoday.com/story/sports/mls/2024/12/19/mls-releases-full-2025-schedule-tv-channel-streaming/77088720007/ |work=[[USA Today]] |department=Pro Soccer Wire |accessdate=December 24, 2024}}{{cite news |last=Zeigler |first=Mark |date=December 19, 2024 |title=San Diego FC learns its full schedule, signs a midfielder |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/2024/12/19/san-diego-fc-learns-its-full-schedule-signs-a-midfielder/ |work=The San Diego Union-Tribune |accessdate=December 19, 2024}} The [[San Jose Earthquakes]] hosted [[D.C. United]] on April 6, 2025, in a nod to the [[San Jose Clash v D.C. United (April 1996)|inaugural MLS match]] played by the same two teams, as part of recognition of the league's 30th anniversary. All MLS games were broadcast on [[MLS Season Pass]] for the third year as part of a [[Major League Soccer on television#2023–2032|ten-year partnership]] between MLS and [[Apple Inc.]] for the broadcast and streaming rights to all MLS and [[Leagues Cup]] games, as well as select [[MLS Next]] and [[MLS Next Pro]] games.{{cite news |last=Noor Haq |first=Sana |date=June 15, 2022 |title=MLS and Apple announce 10-year streaming deal |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/15/football/mls-apple-streaming-deal-spt-intl/index.html |publisher=[[CNN]] |accessdate=October 30, 2022 |archive-date=October 31, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221031043333/https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/15/football/mls-apple-streaming-deal-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live }} The [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]], hosted by the United States, took place during the middle of the season and included MLS participants [[Seattle Sounders FC]], [[Inter Miami CF]], and [[Los Angeles FC]].{{cite news |last=Kaufman |first=Michelle |author-link=Michelle Kaufman |date=October 20, 2024 |title=Inter Miami earns spot in 2025 Club World Cup, will play opener at Hard Rock Stadium |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/mls/inter-miami/article294243004.html |work=[[Miami Herald]] |access-date=October 24, 2024}} The 2025 edition of the Leagues Cup took place between July 29 and August 31.{{cite news |url=https://www.leaguescup.com/news/schedule-updates-announced-for-leagues-cup-2025 |title=Schedule Updates Announced for Leagues Cup 2025 |website=Leagues Cup |date=December 16, 2024 |access-date=December 16, 2024}} The [[LA Galaxy]] were the reigning [[MLS Cup 2024|MLS Cup]] champions and Inter Miami CF were the [[Supporters' Shield]] holders, having set the all-time [[points (association football)|points]] record during the [[2024 Major League Soccer season|2024 season]]. The [[Philadelphia Union]] won the Supporters' Shield for a second time,{{cite news |date=October 4, 2025 |title=Philadelphia Union win 2025 Supporters' Shield |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/philadelphia-union-win-2025-supporters-shield |access-date=October 4, 2025 |publisher=Major League Soccer }} while Inter Miami CF won a first MLS Cup title after defeating [[Vancouver Whitecaps FC]] 3–1 at [[Chase Stadium]] in [[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]].{{cite news |last=Sigal |first=Jonathan |date=December 6, 2025 |title=CHAMPIONS! Inter Miami & Lionel Messi win MLS Cup over Vancouver Whitecaps |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/playoffs/2025/news/champions-inter-miami-lionel-messi-win-mls-cup-over-vancouver-whitecaps |publisher=Major League Soccer |access-date=December 6, 2025 }} == Teams == === Stadiums and locations === {{Main|List of Major League Soccer stadiums}} {{Location map+ |United States |width=525 |float=right |caption=

The regular season included breaks for the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup|FIFA Club World Cup]] and [[2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup|CONCACAF Gold Cup]] from June 15 to 24. Fox Sports aired 34 matches during the 2025 season, with 19 on [[Fox Sports 1]] and 15 on [[Fox Broadcasting Company|Fox]] in English. All 34 matches aired in Spanish on [[Fox Deportes]].{{cite web |date=December 19, 2024 |title=MLS Announces 2025 Regular Season Schedule |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/mls-announces-2025-regular-season-schedule |website=[[Major League Soccer]]|access-date=April 12, 2025}} This was the first year [[DirecTV]] and [[Xfinity]] held the right to distribute MLS Season Pass to residential customers via their cable services.{{cite news |date=January 29, 2025 |title=MLS Season Pass Now Available to DirecTV Residential Customers for the First Time |url=https://www.directv.com/insider/mls-season-pass-available-on-directv/ |publisher=[[DirecTV]] |access-date=January 30, 2025}} For the first time, several teams announced agreements with local [[terrestrial television|over-the-air stations]], to rebroadcast matches at least 48 hours after their conclusion. FC Dallas announced an agreement with [[KDFI|KDFI-TV]], Charlotte FC with [[WAXN-TV]], FC Cincinnati with [[WXIX|WXIX-TV]] and [[Rock Entertainment Sports Network]], LAFC with [[KCOP-TV]], St. Louis City SC with [[KMOV|KMOV-TV (the Matrix Midwest network)]] and the Seattle Sounders with [[KCPQ|KCPQ-TV]]. TSN and RDS aired 41 matches during the 2025 season.{{cite web |date=February 5, 2025 |title=MLS Announces TSN and RDS Broadcast Schedules for the 2025 Regular Season |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/mls-announces-tsn-and-rds-broadcast-schedules-for-the-2025-regular-season |website=[[Major League Soccer]]|access-date=April 12, 2025}} ===International=== Internationally, since Apple TV acquired the rights to Major League Soccer in 2023, MLS Season Pass exclusively aired the MLS outside the United States and Canada.
